title: Citizen
description: Canonical citizen schema — single source of truth across all departments. Aligned with IndEA (India Enterprise Architecture) entity conventions.

canonicalId.description: System-generated canonical identifier (UUID). This is the golden record ID from the MDM service.

name.description: Full name of the citizen (normalized: trimmed, title-case).

dateOfBirth.description: Date of birth in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

departmentLinks.description: Links to this citizen's records in each department system. Populated by the MDM matching service.

departmentId.description: The citizen's identifier in that department's system (e.g. citizen_uid, ApplicantID, beneficiary_code).

departmentIdField.description: Name of the ID field in the department's native schema.
